title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 4,101–4,150 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 農業科技；現代智慧農業

examples.en: High-tech smart agriculture integrates IoT sensors, cloud monitoring, and precision robotics.
examples.zh: 高科技智慧農業整合了物聯網感測器、雲端氣候監控與精密自走採收機器人。

examples.en: Sustainable agriculture practices help conserve precious groundwater reserves.
examples.zh: 推廣環境永續農法有助於涵養並守護珍貴的地下水資源庫。

examples.en: Agriculture remains the foundational backbone of many regional economies worldwide.
examples.zh: 農業自古以來始終是全球無數區域經濟最不可或缺的堅實基石。

examples.en: Young tech-savvy growers returned to rural hometowns to innovate organic farming.
examples.zh: 具備科技背景的返鄉青年農民（青農）回到農村故鄉，以創新思維導入有機友善農法。

examples.en: Local orchid growers export millions of vibrant phalaenopsis stems annually.
examples.zh: 在地蝴蝶蘭栽種農友每年向歐美日等國外銷數百萬株色彩絢麗的精品蝴蝶蘭切花。

examples.en: The association provides workshops to help commercial apple growers adopt organic methods.
examples.zh: 農會定期開辦專業研習工作坊，輔導商業蘋果果農轉型接軌有機栽培體系。

examples.en: Automated climate-controlled greenhouses protect delicate strawberries from pests and typhoons.
examples.zh: 配備智慧微氣候環控系統的高規格溫室能保護嬌貴的有機草莓免受病蟲害與強烈颱風侵襲。

examples.en: Solar panels mounted on the greenhouse roof generate renewable energy for ventilation fans.
examples.zh: 安裝在溫室棚頂的太陽能光電板能產生源源不絕的綠能，驅動內部通風循環風扇運轉。

examples.en: Walking into the glass greenhouse filled with blooming tropical orchids felt like paradise.
examples.zh: 漫步走進開滿各色熱帶蘭花的玻璃溫室之中，宛如置身於夢幻迷人的綠色天堂。

words.definition: 水耕栽培技術；無土栽培

examples.en: Vertical hydroponics grows crisp leafy lettuce indoors using mineral nutrient solutions.
examples.zh: 垂直多層水耕栽培技術在室內植物工廠中利用精密調配的礦物營養水溶液培育鮮脆萵苣。

examples.en: Urban rooftops transformed by hydroponics produce fresh vegetables with ninety percent less water.
examples.zh: 經過水耕農法改造的都會大樓屋頂菜園，能以省水高達百分之九十的驚人效率生產新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: Hydroponics allows farmers to grow fresh produce in arid desert environments where soil is barren.
examples.zh: 無土水耕栽培技術讓農民得以在土地貧瘠乾旱的荒漠環境中，全年生產純淨新鮮的蔬果。

examples.en: Solar-powered drip irrigation delivers micro-droplets of water directly to plant root zones.
examples.zh: 太陽能驅動的智慧精準微量滴灌系統能將每一滴寶貴水資源與液肥精準送達作物根系深處。

examples.en: Building modern irrigation canals transformed dry parched fields into fertile farmland.
examples.zh: 修築現代化的水利灌溉溝渠灌溉網絡，將原本乾涸龜裂的貧瘠荒地變身為良田沃土。

examples.en: Automated irrigation systems monitor real-time soil moisture sensors before activating water valves.
examples.zh: 自動化智慧灌溉系統在開啟電動給水閥門之前，會實時讀取土壤水分感測器回傳的濕度數據。

words.definition: 自動化控制；自動化運作

examples.en: Greenhouse roof vents and automated shade curtains adjust based on external sunlight sensors.
examples.zh: 溫室天窗通風扇與自動化遮陰捲簾會依據室外光照強度感測器數據自動展開升降。

examples.en: Increasing farm automation helps resolve chronic labor shortages during seasonal harvests.
examples.zh: 大幅導入智慧農業自動化設備，能有效緩解農忙採收期長期面臨的農業缺工問題。

examples.en: Robotic packaging automation swiftly weighs, seals, and labels produce for supermarket distribution.
examples.zh: 機器人包裝自動化產線能極速完成蔬果的精準秤重、熱壓封口與產銷標籤貼合作業。

examples.en: Misting nozzles cool the greenhouse microclimate during scorching subtropical summer afternoons.
examples.zh: 高壓微霧噴頭能在酷熱難耐的亞熱帶夏日午後迅速為溫室內部微氣候降溫加濕。

examples.en: Sheltered valleys create a unique microclimate shielded from harsh coastal winter gales.
examples.zh: 避風的幽靜山谷孕育出了獨特的溫和微氣候，天然抵擋了沿海地區冬季呼嘯的凜冽強風。

examples.en: Sensors measure temperature, humidity, and carbon dioxide to maintain an ideal greenhouse microclimate.
examples.zh: 環控感測器全天候監控溫濕度與二氧化碳濃度，以維繫溫室內部最適作物的微氣候環境。

words.definition: 產銷履歷制度；可溯源性 (TAP)

examples.en: Taiwan's TAP food traceability label ensures full transparency from farmland to dining table.
examples.zh: 台灣產銷履歷農產品（TAP）標章能確保從產地採收、用藥紀錄到餐桌銷售的全然透明公開。

examples.en: Blockchain technology enhances supply chain traceability for premium organic coffee beans.
examples.zh: 導入區塊鏈技術能顯著提升精品有機咖啡豆在跨國供應鏈全程的可追溯性與防偽性。

examples.en: Strict traceability guidelines reassure consumers regarding safe livestock feed and animal welfare.
examples.zh: 嚴格落實的食品溯源體系能讓消費者完全放心牲畜飼料配方安全與人道動物福祉保障。

examples.en: Shoppers scan the QR code on the melon to verify harvest dates and farmer identities.
examples.zh: 消費者在超市拿起香甜洋香瓜隨手掃描包裝上的 QR Code，即可秒查採收日期與生產青農姓名。

examples.en: Security officers scan carry-on backpacks with advanced X-ray equipment at the airport terminal.
examples.zh: 機場航廈安檢人員運用先進的 3D 電腦斷層 X 光儀，嚴密掃描每位旅客的隨身行李後背包。

examples.en: A quick scan of the financial audit report revealed unexpected accounting discrepancies.
examples.zh: 快速審視瀏覽這份財務審計稽核報告，迅速察覺了幾處出人意料的會計帳目出入。

words.definition: 有機農產品標章認證；證明書

examples.en: Strict organic certification requires zero synthetic chemical pesticides and synthetic fertilizers.
examples.zh: 嚴格的國立有機農產品認證標準明令要求耕作全程零化學農藥、零合成化肥與零重金屬污染。

examples.en: Achieving international fair-trade certification opened lucrative export markets for small farmers.
examples.zh: 順利取得國際公平貿易標章認證，為純樸山區的獨立小農叩開了高附加價值的外銷市場大門。

examples.en: Inspectors conducted an unannounced farm audit before renewing the organic soil certification.
examples.zh: 驗證機構稽核員在核發土壤有機更新認證證書前，專程進行了一場突擊式的無預警現場抽檢。

examples.en: Rigorous laboratory testing confirmed zero pesticide residues on all harvested cherry tomatoes.
examples.zh: 第三方公證實驗室的精密質譜快檢證實，該批採收的玉女小番茄完全符合零農藥殘留標準。

examples.en: Wash apples thoroughly under running tap water to remove waxy surface residue.
examples.zh: 在流動的乾淨自來水下反覆沖洗蘋果，能有效除淨果皮表層可能附著的微量果蠟與殘留物。

examples.en: A stubborn chemical residue remained encrusted at the bottom of the test flask.
examples.zh: 一層頑固難除的白色化學沉澱殘留物，緊緊凝結附著在實驗燒瓶底部邊角處。

words.definition: 微生物菌肥；生物有機肥

examples.en: Inoculating soil with beneficial bio-fertilizers boosts nutrient uptake and root vitality.
examples.zh: 在根圈土壤中施用優質枯草芽孢桿菌等微生物生物肥料，能大幅提升養分吸收率與根系活力。

examples.en: Unlike synthetic nitrogen, applying bio-fertilizer prevents chemical soil acidification over time.
examples.zh: 與傳統化學氮肥不同，定期施用生物有機肥能從根本上預防土壤酸化硬化的老化現象。

examples.en: Farmers blend compost with bio-fertilizers to nurture millions of active soil microorganisms.
examples.zh: 果農將充分腐熟的天然堆肥拌入微生物菌肥，在土壤中培育數以億計的微細活性有益菌。

examples.en: Organic farmers release beneficial insects like ladybugs to consume harmful aphid colonies.
examples.zh: 有機果農在園區野放瓢蟲與草蛉等天敵益蟲，利用大自然食物鏈天然剋制惱人的蚜蟲害。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise delivers beneficial effects for cardiovascular health and longevity.
examples.zh: 每週規律進行有氧耐力運動，對促進心血管健康循環與延年益壽有著不可估量的有益助益。

examples.en: Gentle summer showers proved highly beneficial to newly sprouted corn seedlings.
examples.zh: 仲夏午後降下的一場及時甘霖微雨，對剛剛破土萌芽的鮮綠玉米幼苗帶來了極大的滋養。

examples.en: Biological pest control replaces chemical pesticides, preserving beneficial honeybee populations.
examples.zh: 採用天敵與性費洛蒙誘捕等生物防治法取代劇毒農藥，能保護辛勤授粉的野生蜜蜂族群。

examples.en: Students observed the intricate biological life cycle of silkworms in science class.
examples.zh: 國小自然科學課堂上，學童們透過放大鏡聚精會神觀察蠶寶寶神奇完整的生物生命週期變態。

examples.en: Biological washing powders contain active natural enzymes that break down stubborn protein stains.
examples.zh: 生物酵素洗衣精蘊含高活性天然蛋白酵素，能以溫和方式徹底分解衣物上的頑固血漬汗斑。

examples.en: Introducing greenhouse bumblebee hives ensures consistent, natural tomato flower pollination.
examples.zh: 在密閉溫室內引進人工飼養的溫室熊蜂蜂巢，能確保每一朵番茄花朵皆獲得均勻天然授粉。

examples.en: Wind and buzzing native bees facilitate essential pollination for healthy fruit orchards.
examples.zh: 溫和的穿堂微風與穿梭花叢間的本土野蜂，共同促成了果園果樹繁茂結果不可或缺的花粉傳播。

examples.en: Without cross-pollination between compatible varieties, almond trees will fail to bear nuts.
examples.zh: 若缺乏不同互補品種之間的異花授粉，整片杏仁樹林將開花而不結果，無法順利結出堅果。

words.definition: 作物輪作；輪流更替；旋轉

examples.en: Crop rotation between nitrogen-fixing legumes and corn prevents soil nutrient depletion.
examples.zh: 在田區實施固氮豆科作物與甜玉米的輪作休耕制度，能有效防止土壤特定單一養分耗竭。

examples.en: Hospital nurses work on a scheduled monthly night shift rotation to ensure adequate rest.
examples.zh: 醫學中心護理團隊嚴格落實排定好的每月大夜班輪班輪調機制，確保醫護人員享有充分休養。

examples.en: The continuous rotation of the turbine generates clean electrical power for nearby homes.
examples.zh: 水力發電渦輪機日夜不息的持續高速旋轉，為鄰近村落數千戶家庭輸送源源不絕的純淨綠電。

words.definition: 綠肥覆蓋作物（如田菁、向日葵）

examples.en: Plowing blooming clover cover crops into the field replenishes rich organic matter naturally.
examples.zh: 在休耕期將滿園盛開的田菁與油菜花綠肥覆蓋作物翻耕入土，能為土地自然補充豐沛有機質。

examples.en: Planting winter cover crops prevents fertile topsoil from blowing away in fierce winter winds.
examples.zh: 在休耕期栽種耐寒冬生綠肥覆蓋作物，能防止表層肥沃腐殖土被冬日呼嘯的九降風吹襲流失。

examples.en: Sunflowers serve as both a pollinator haven and an effective cover crop during post-harvest fallow.
examples.zh: 在二期稻作收割後的休耕農田中滿植向日葵，既是蜜蜂授粉天堂，更是改善地力的絕佳綠肥作物。

examples.en: Terracing steep slopes and planting vetiver grass stops catastrophic tropical soil erosion.
examples.zh: 在陡峭山坡地修築等高線梯田並密植培地茅草帶，能有效遏止暴雨沖刷造成的水土流失。

examples.en: Relentless ocean wave action caused noticeable coastal bluff erosion over the decades.
examples.zh: 數十年來洶湧海浪拍打海岸的不懈侵蝕沖刷，導致沿海高聳的懸崖峭壁出現顯著坍塌後退。

examples.en: Planting deep-rooted native trees along riverbanks protects shorelines against storm erosion.
examples.zh: 在野溪河岸兩側密植深根性台灣原生種樹木，能在暴風雨暴漲時守護堤岸免於遭受劇烈沖蝕。

examples.en: Volcanic plains in eastern Taiwan provide exceptionally fertile soil for award-winning rice.
examples.zh: 台灣花東縱谷秀姑巒溪流域的純淨沃土為孕育世界金牌冠軍池上米提供了極致肥沃的土壤。

examples.en: Regular additions of compost and aged manure transform sandy earth into fertile loam.
examples.zh: 定期在田間施入充分熟化的腐植質堆肥與發酵牛糞，能將貧瘠沙質土改良為鬆軟肥沃的壤土。

examples.en: The fertile imagination of the novelist produced dozens of bestselling fantasy tales.
examples.zh: 這位奇幻小說家腦海中如泉湧般無窮無盡的豐富想像力，創作出數十部暢銷全球的冒險傳奇。

examples.en: Eating seasonal produce guarantees peak nutritional value and unmatched natural sweetness.
examples.zh: 遵循大自然節氣享用當季當令盛產的在地蔬果，營養價值最為充沛且風味甘甜多汁。

examples.en: Ski resort lodges hire hundreds of temporary seasonal workers during snowy winter peaks.
examples.zh: 位於高山雪原的滑雪度假山莊，每逢大雪紛飛的冬季旅遊旺季便會招募數百名短期季節性員工。

examples.en: Seasonal allergies triggered by spring cedar pollen cause sneezing and watery eyes.
examples.zh: 初春時節隨風飄散的杉木花粉所引發的季節性過敏反應，常讓人止不住打噴嚏、眼眶泛紅流淚。

words.definition: 在地食材採購；尋找產地來源

examples.en: Michelin restaurants commit to local sourcing by partnering directly with smallholder farmers.
examples.zh: 頂級星級米其林綠星餐廳秉持在地永續採購原則，直接與全台友善耕作的優質獨立小農契作。

examples.en: Ethical garment companies audit global textile factories to guarantee responsible fabric sourcing.
examples.zh: 恪守社會責任的良心服飾品牌會對全球紡織供應鏈展開嚴格稽查，確保布料來源合乎道德人道。

examples.en: Direct sourcing eliminates middlemen and ensures fair profit margins for rural coffee cooperatives.
examples.zh: 從產地源頭直接採購剔除了層層盤商中間剝削，切實保障了偏鄉咖啡產銷合作社農友的公平利潤。

words.definition: 產地到餐桌的；新鮮直送的

examples.en: The farm-to-table dining concept celebrates fresh morning-harvested vegetables served at dinner.
examples.zh: 「從產地到餐桌」（Farm-to-Table）的美食哲學推崇將清晨露水未乾現採的鮮蔬於當晚端上餐桌。

examples.en: Diners love the transparent storytelling behind every ingredient in this farm-to-table bistro.
examples.zh: 老饕們深深著迷於這間產地直送私房餐酒館在每一道佳餚背後所深情講述的食材產地人文故事。

examples.en: Promoting farm-to-table values fosters deeper connections between urban dwellers and rural agriculture.
examples.zh: 大力提倡產地到餐桌的飲食理念，能重新牽起都市都會居民與鄉村土地農業之間失落已久的深厚連結。

words.definition: 食物里程（食材運送距離）

examples.en: Buying local Taiwanese fruit drastically lowers food miles compared to imported grapes.
examples.zh: 優先選購台灣本土在地盛產的新鮮水果，比起遠渡重洋進口的空運水果能大幅縮減食物里程。

examples.en: Calculating food miles helps environmentally aware shoppers make lower-carbon grocery choices.
examples.zh: 精確計算每樣食材運輸所產生的食物里程，能協助具備環保意識的綠色消費者做出低碳採購選擇。

examples.en: Reducing food miles through regional supply chains lowers transportation greenhouse gas emissions.
examples.zh: 透過構建區域在地農產供應鏈以顯著縮減食物里程，能從源頭大幅削減交通運輸長途碳排。

words.definition: 小農市集；假日農夫市集

examples.en: Families love visiting weekend farmers markets to buy organic honey directly from beekeepers.
examples.zh: 爸爸媽媽在週末假日熱愛帶著孩子造訪希望廣場小農市集，直接向辛苦蜂農選購純天然百花蜜。

examples.en: Fresh artisan cheeses, sourdough loaves, and colorful carrots fill the lively farmers market stalls.
examples.zh: 手工熟成乳酪、香酥天然酸種麵包與七彩胡蘿蔔擺滿了小農市集攤位，充滿了蓬勃生機。

examples.en: Chatting directly with producers at the farmers market helps shoppers learn authentic cooking tips.
examples.zh: 在小農市集與親手耕種的農民面對面熱情交談，能讓顧客學到最道地、最接地氣的私房料理秘訣。

words.definition: 產地蔬果嚐鮮箱訂閱；訂購

examples.en: Subscribers receive a weekly CSA vegetable subscription box packed with seasonal organic greens.
examples.zh: 加入產地蔬果嚐鮮箱週週定期訂閱配送服務，每週皆能在家開箱收到農場直送的新鮮有機蔬菜。

examples.en: She cancelled her magazine subscription and switched to an ad-free digital news platform.
examples.zh: 她退訂了紙本雜誌的郵寄訂閱，全面轉移使用無惱人廣告干擾的優質數位付費新聞閱讀平台。

examples.en: Monthly subscription boxes for specialty coffee introduce roaster profiles from across the globe.
examples.zh: 精品咖啡豆每月訂閱驚喜盒定期寄送，讓咖啡愛好者足不出戶即可品味全球頂級獨立烘焙商的作品。

words.definition: 農業產銷合作社；合作的

examples.en: Local fruit cooperatives bundle harvest volumes to negotiate better wholesale market prices.
examples.zh: 地區頂級芒果產銷合作社集結全體產銷班社員產能，在台北第一果菜批發市場爭取最佳拍賣拍價。

examples.en: Joining an agricultural cooperative gives smallholders shared access to expensive sorting machinery.
examples.zh: 加入農業產銷合作社讓資源有限的小農得以共同出資使用高科技光波甜度篩選與自動分級機。

examples.en: The students formed a cooperative study group to tackle challenging calculus assignments together.
examples.zh: 大學同學們自發組成了一個互助合作讀書會，同心協力攻克艱澀繁複的微積分作業習題。

words.definition: 契作合約；契約耕作；簽約

examples.en: Beverage companies sign long-term contract farming agreements with organic tea plantations.
examples.zh: 知名連鎖精品茶飲集團與南投名間有機茶園簽署長期契作收購合約，保障茶農穩定收益。

examples.en: Review the legal terms of the lease contract carefully before signing and paying the deposit.
examples.zh: 在正式提筆簽名並轉帳支付昂貴押金之前，務必逐字逐條審閱房屋租賃契約合約的法律條款。

examples.en: Muscle fibers naturally contract and shorten to generate physical force during weight lifting.
examples.zh: 在重訓推舉槓鈴施力做功的過程中，人體骨骼肌纖維會自然而然地緊繃收縮以產生強大力量。

words.definition: 產地全程冷鏈低溫物流

examples.en: An unbroken cold chain preserves crunchy texture and sweet flavor during transport.
examples.zh: 建立從田間採收、預冷包裝到低溫冷藏車配送不斷鏈的「全程冷鏈物流」，是維持鮮脆的關鍵。

examples.en: Temperature data loggers verify that the cold chain remained strictly between 2°C and 4°C throughout shipping.
examples.zh: 隨車溫濕度連續記錄儀能全程驗證低溫冷鏈運送過程中，車廂溫度始終嚴格維持在攝氏二至四度。

examples.en: Distributing vaccines across tropical islands requires dependable solar-powered cold chain equipment.
examples.zh: 在熱帶島嶼之間長途配送高敏感度生物疫苗，需要仰賴極其穩定可靠的太陽能低溫冷鏈保鮮設備。

words.definition: 採後真空預冷保鮮技術

examples.en: Vacuum pre-cooling removes field heat from freshly harvested lettuce within twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 透過先進的真空預冷保鮮技術，能在二十分鐘內迅速抽除剛採收結球萵苣體內的田間田野餘熱。

examples.en: Immediate post-harvest pre-cooling slows down plant respiration and prevents premature wilting.
examples.zh: 採收後立即落實真空低溫預冷能有效減緩蔬果自身的呼吸代謝速率，防止葉片提早萎凋失水。

examples.en: Installing a modern forced-air pre-cooling facility dramatically reduced post-harvest crop spoilage.
examples.zh: 產地集貨包裝場導入現代化壓差強制風冷預冷設備，大幅降低了新鮮蔬果採後運銷的腐爛損耗率。

words.definition: 蔬果貨架賞味期；保質期

examples.en: Advanced breathable modified-atmosphere bags extend fresh guava shelf life by two weeks.
examples.zh: 採用高科技微孔透氣氣調保鮮袋包裝，能將新鮮外銷珍珠芭樂的貨架上架賞味期延長兩週以上。

examples.en: Pasteurized milk has a significantly longer refrigerated shelf life than raw unpasteurized milk.
examples.zh: 經過高溫巴氏殺菌處理的鮮乳在冷藏條件下的商品保存保質期，遠長於未經殺菌的生乳。

examples.en: Preservative-free artisanal sourdough loaves have a natural shelf life of roughly three to four days.
examples.zh: 完全無添加化學防腐劑的手工天然酸種麵包，在常溫陰涼處的自然賞味保質期大約為三至四天。

examples.en: Developing food literacy helps children understand how seasons, soil, and farmers sustain life.
examples.zh: 推廣全民食農教育素養能讓下一代深刻體會大自然節氣、土壤沃度與辛勤農民如何滋養生命。

examples.en: Digital literacy has become an essential life skill for navigating modern online public services.
examples.zh: 在數位時代，資訊數位素養已成為每位公民日常順暢申辦各項線上公共政務不可或缺的核心能力。

examples.en: School cooking programs foster nutrition literacy by teaching teenagers to prepare balanced meals.
examples.zh: 國高中家政烹飪實作課程透過手把手教導青少年烹煮均衡三餐，深耕健全的膳食營養教育素養。

examples.en: Agri-tourism farms provide hands-on experiential picking tours for curious city schoolchildren.
examples.zh: 休閒農業觀光果園為平日生活在都會水泥叢林中的學童提供親手拔蘿蔔、採草莓的體驗式教學。

examples.en: Experiential learning allows students to master complex scientific principles through direct experimentation.
examples.zh: 體驗式學習讓學子得以跳脫死板教科書文字，透過動手實踐與科學實驗深刻融會貫通核心原理。

examples.en: The luxury brand created an immersive, experiential pop-up exhibition to engage younger consumers.
examples.zh: 國際頂級時尚奢侈品牌精心策劃了一場沉浸式體驗快閃展覽，以與年輕新世代消費者深度對話。

examples.en: Irrigated rice paddies form shimmering green mirrors across the Yilan countryside.
examples.zh: 陽光普照下注滿清澈山泉水的水稻田宛如一面面波光粼粼的翡翠明鏡，倒映著宜蘭美麗天際線。

examples.en: Migrating ducks forage for leftover grains in muddy rice paddies during the quiet winter months.
examples.zh: 在靜謐悠閒的寒冬農閒月份，成群結隊的遷徙候鳥野鴨在泥濘的水稻田中覓食散落的稻穀。

examples.en: Walking along narrow raised footpaths between green paddies is a quintessential rural memory.
examples.zh: 漫步在兩側滿眼翠綠秧苗的田埂羊腸小徑上，是每位台灣人童年記憶深處最溫暖的鄉村風情。

examples.en: Modern riding rice transplanting machines plant ten thousand seedlings in one morning.
examples.zh: 現代化乘座式自走式高速水稻插秧機僅需短短一個上午，即可高效完成數萬株嫩綠秧苗的插秧。

examples.en: Spring transplanting requires delicate handling to keep tender seedling root structures intact.
examples.zh: 早春水稻插秧移栽作業需要輕柔謹慎，確保嬌嫩脆弱的幼苗根盤組織完整無損以便迅速定根。

examples.en: The traditional village community gathered together to assist neighbors during manual rice transplanting.
examples.zh: 在傳統農耕社會裡，整座村落的左鄰右舍每逢春分農忙總會熱情換工互助，合力完成手工插秧。

examples.en: Lush hillside citrus orchards in Hsinchu produce famously sweet ponkan mandarins.
examples.zh: 新埔與峨眉山坡地上結實纍纍的柑橘觀光果園盛產果汁飽滿、甜美多汁的極品桶柑與椪柑。

examples.en: Tourists flocked to the hillside cherry orchard to pick sweet fruit under sunny blue skies.
examples.zh: 大批觀光客趁著晴空萬里的晴朗藍天，爭相造訪向陽山坡上的櫻桃園親手採摘甜美櫻桃。

examples.en: Pruning overgrown fruit trees each winter keeps the commercial apple orchard healthy and highly productive.
examples.zh: 每年嚴冬農閒期為過度徒長的果樹進行細緻修剪疏枝，能確保商業蘋果果園常保生機並維持高產。

examples.en: Tainan Yujing is world-renowned for luscious, ruby-red Aiwen Irwin mangoes.
examples.zh: 台南玉井以香氣馥郁濃烈、果肉細嫩金黃無絲、外皮艷紅如紅寶石般的頂級愛文芒果聞名遐邇。

examples.en: A towering bowl of shaved ice topped with sweet fresh mango chunks and condensed milk is iconic.
examples.zh: 一大碗堆成小山般、鋪滿香甜現切芒果丁並淋上濃郁煉乳的芒果雪花冰，是台灣夏日的招牌象徵。

examples.en: Taiwan's agricultural scientists bred distinct mango cultivars that offer unique aromas and silky flesh.
examples.zh: 台灣農業研發團隊培育出各具特色與迷人香氣的優良芒果新品種，果肉細膩如絲且甜度驚人。

words.definition: 蓮霧（黑珍珠／黑金剛蓮霧）

examples.en: Pingtung Black Pearl wax apples are prized for their crisp bite and floral sweetness.
examples.zh: 屏東林邊沿海以天然微鹹海水栽培出的黑珍珠蓮霧色澤黝黑發亮、口感清脆爽口、清甜多汁。

examples.en: Biting into a chilled wax apple provides instant hydration and refreshing tropical relief.
examples.zh: 大口咬下一顆冰鎮過的爽脆黑金剛蓮霧，清甜汁水瞬間爆發，帶來無比消暑沁涼的熱帶快感。

examples.en: Gift boxes filled with giant dark purple wax apples are among the most prestigious seasonal gifts.
examples.zh: 裝滿色澤黑紫透亮、個頭碩大的特級黑金剛蓮霧頂級水果禮盒，是逢年過節最顯尊貴大氣的頂級伴手禮。

examples.en: Tainung No. 17 Golden Diamond pineapples feature edible sweet cores with zero tongue stinging.
examples.zh: 享譽國際的台農十七號金鑽鳳梨甜度極高且連鳳梨心都細嫩香甜可食，完全不咬舌刮嘴。

examples.en: Golden pineapple shortcakes baked with pure winter melon and fruit jam are popular souvenirs.
examples.zh: 以純土鳳梨果醬與冬瓜餡料悉心烘烤出的金黃鳳梨酥，是各國觀光客遊台必買的人氣伴手禮王牌。

examples.en: In Taiwanese culture, pineapples symbolize good luck and prosperity because their name sounds like 'wealth arrives'.
examples.zh: 在台灣民俗文化中，鳳梨台語諧音「旺來」，象徵好運連連與財源廣進，逢年過節不可或缺。

examples.en: Vibrant crimson red-flesh dragon fruits are packed with antioxidant anthocyanins and dietary fiber.
examples.zh: 果肉艷紅如玫瑰花瓣的紅肉火龍果富含珍貴的天然抗氧化花青素與豐富水溶性膳食纖維。

examples.en: She blended frozen dragon fruit cubes into a brilliant magenta smoothie bowl for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她在早餐時將冷凍紅肉火龍果丁放入調理機攪打，做出一碗色澤驚艷奪目的芭比桃紅果昔碗。

examples.en: The striking scaly outer skin of the dragon fruit makes it one of the most distinctive exotic fruits.
examples.zh: 火龍果外表覆蓋著如同巨龍鱗片般醒目鮮綠的奇特萼片，是熱帶水果中最具辨識度的外貌擔當。

examples.en: Crisp Yanchao Pearl guavas sprinkled with sweet plum powder make a refreshing snack.
examples.zh: 來自高雄燕巢泥火山沃土培育出的鮮脆珍珠芭樂切片後撒上一層酸甜梅子粉，滋味無比生津。

examples.en: Fresh guava boasts an exceptionally high concentration of vitamin C compared to citrus fruits.
examples.zh: 新鮮芭樂中所蘊含的天然維生素 C 含量冠絕群雄，其濃度遠遠超越了傳統的柑橘與檸檬。

examples.en: Night market vendors display pyramids of freshly sliced guava seasoned with licorice and salt.
examples.zh: 台灣各大夜市現切水果攤位前，總陳列著一座座撒上甘草鹽、水潤脆口的新鮮芭樂切片金字塔。

examples.en: Hanging netting orchards in Nantou Puli prevent ripe purple passion fruits from bruising.
examples.zh: 南投埔里大坪頂百香果園全面架設懸空防撞吊網，確保自然熟落的紫紅百香果顆顆完美無撞傷。

examples.en: Spooning tangy yellow passion fruit pulp over vanilla panna cotta balances sweetness brilliantly.
examples.zh: 將酸香濃郁、金黃多汁的百香果果肉舀在香草奶酪上，能以明亮果酸完美平衡奶香甜度。

examples.en: Bubble tea shops craft refreshing green tea beverages infused with fragrant fresh passion fruit juice.
examples.zh: 連鎖手搖飲名店調製出將茉莉綠茶與現挖百香果汁完美融合的百香綠茶，是夏日暢銷長青樹。

examples.en: Sweet, juicy old-vine Wentan pomelos from Madou are the iconic Mid-Autumn festival treat.
examples.zh: 台南麻豆樹齡數十載的老欉文旦柚果肉細緻如玉、甘甜多汁，是中秋佳節最受歡迎的應景佳品。

examples.en: Children love peeling thick pomelo rinds and wearing the hollow green peels as playful hats.
examples.zh: 台灣小朋友最喜歡在中秋夜將厚厚綠色文旦柚子皮完整剝下，當作搞怪可愛的小帽子戴在頭上。

examples.en: Allow freshly picked pomelos to sit in a dry room for a week to let the rind soften and sugars concentrate.
examples.zh: 剛採收的文旦宜放在陰涼通風處常溫「辭水」（消水）一週，待果皮微皺變軟後果肉甜度達到巔峰。

examples.en: Roasted golden sweet potatoes from Jinshan are creamy, sweet, and comforting on chilly nights.
examples.zh: 新北金山出產的台農五十七號現烤紅外線黃金地瓜肉質綿密如蜜，在寒冷冬夜吃上一口暖入心扉。

examples.en: Steamed purple sweet potatoes provide nutrient-dense complex carbohydrates for athletic recovery.
examples.zh: 蒸煮熟透的天然紫心甘薯能為運動員訓練後的肌力修復，提供營養豐富的優質複合碳水化合物。

examples.en: The geographical contour of Taiwan island is famously said to resemble the shape of a sweet potato.
examples.zh: 台灣本島在世界地圖上的地理形狀輪廓，在民間向來被親切地比擬為一條飽滿質樸的番薯。

examples.en: Lishan high-mountain cabbage develops natural sugary crispness under wide day-night temperature swings.
examples.zh: 生長在海拔兩千公尺梨山的大日夜溫差環境下，高山高麗菜自然凝結出極致清甜、鮮脆爽口的頂級口感。

examples.en: Quickly stir-fry shredded cabbage with minced garlic and chili over blazing high wok heat.
examples.zh: 在燒得滾燙的鐵鍋中將手撕高麗菜搭配蒜末與辣椒大火快炒，十數秒即可炒出鍋氣撲鼻的鮮脆美味。

examples.en: Fermenting shredded cabbage with salt and spices produces traditional probiotic-rich sauerkraut.
examples.zh: 將細切甘藍高麗菜絲加入海鹽與天然香料封罐慢速自然乳酸發酵，能做出富含活性益生菌的德式酸菜。

examples.en: Chilled, freshly dug green bamboo shoots paired with Japanese mayonnaise taste like sweet pears.
examples.zh: 清晨現挖直送的當季鮮嫩綠竹筍冰鎮切塊後沾裹日式美乃滋，口感清脆甘甜宛如水梨。

examples.en: Farmers wake up before dawn to harvest tender bamboo shoots before the tips break ground into sunlight.
examples.zh: 筍農每逢採筍季節皆在破曉前戴著頭燈搶先採收，在筍尖尚未探出土表見光出青前挖起以保鮮甜。

examples.en: Simmering winter pork ribs with sliced sweet bamboo shoots yields a clear, deeply soothing broth.
examples.zh: 將排骨與切塊甜筍在砂鍋中以小火文火慢燉數小時，能熬出一鍋清甜甘醇、撫慰心脾的竹筍排骨湯。

examples.en: Rigorous multi-tier farm inspections ensure strict national food safety compliance.
examples.zh: 產官學多方攜手落實多重產地抽驗與源頭控管，為全體國人的每日三餐食品安全嚴格把關。

examples.en: Always wear protective helmet and steel-toed boots to ensure personal safety on construction sites.
examples.zh: 在進出工務建設工地現場時，請務必全程規範佩戴工程安全帽與防穿刺鋼頭工作鞋以確保人身安全。

examples.en: Strict food safety protocols protect public health against harmful bacterial contamination outbreaks.
examples.zh: 全面落實嚴謹標準的食品安全作業規範，能有效築牢公共衛生防線，防堵致病細菌交叉污染。

words.definition: 友善土地看守責任；環境管家精神

examples.en: Thoughtful land stewardship ensures productive, non-toxic agricultural soil for our grandchildren.
examples.zh: 秉持敬畏大自然的土地守護者看守精神（Land Stewardship），為子孫後代守護純淨無毒的肥沃良田。

examples.en: Indigenous communities model wise environmental stewardship by harvesting forest resources with deep restraint.
examples.zh: 原住民族部落世代傳承敬畏山林的土地管家智慧，以極度克制與感恩的心態採集山林資源。

examples.en: Corporate environmental stewardship involves cutting emissions and eliminating single-use packaging.
examples.zh: 現代企業落實環境保護管家責任，涵蓋大幅削減工廠碳排放與全面淘汰一次性塑膠包材。

words.definition: 農業生物多樣性；物種多樣性

examples.en: Eco-friendly rice paddies foster rich wetland biodiversity, sheltering frogs and waterbirds.
examples.zh: 堅持不灑農藥的有機友善水稻田復育了生氣盎然的濕地生物多樣性，成為台北赤蛙與水鳥的樂園。

examples.en: Protecting fragile tropical coral reefs preserves vital marine biodiversity against climate change.
examples.zh: 竭力守護嬌弱敏感的熱帶珊瑚礁生態系，能為海洋維繫抵禦全球氣候變遷衝擊的關鍵生物多樣性。

examples.en: Monoculture tree plantations support far less native biodiversity than natural old-growth rainforests.
examples.zh: 單一樹種的人工商業林木造林地所能承載的原生生物多樣性，遠遠低於動植物共生的天然原始雨林。

examples.en: Ancient proverbs remind us to cherish every single precious grain of rice.
examples.zh: 「誰知盤中飧，粒粒皆辛苦」，古老農耕智慧時刻提醒著我們應當常懷感恩、珍惜每一粒珍貴米糧。

examples.en: Nutritionists advise incorporating whole grains like brown rice and rolled oats into your diet.
examples.zh: 權威營養學專家極力建議在日常三餐中多方攝取糙米、黑米與大燕麥等未精緻全穀雜糧穀物。

examples.en: Take his dramatic courtroom exaggerations with a grain of salt because he likes attention.
examples.zh: 對於他在法庭上過度戲劇化且誇大其詞的說法請抱持懷疑態度（半信半疑），因為他向來愛博眼球。

examples.en: The autumn harvest festival celebrated the earth's rich agricultural abundance and hard labor.
examples.zh: 在金黃稻浪起伏的秋收感恩祭典上，全體村民歡聚一堂，由衷感恩大地賜予的豐饒物產與辛勤耕耘。

examples.en: Taiwan's fertile climate produces an astounding abundance of sweet tropical fruits year-round.
examples.zh: 台灣得天獨厚的亞熱帶與熱帶氣候條件，全年源源不絕孕育出琳瑯滿目、令人驚嘆的甘美豐饒果物。

examples.en: She radiated an inner mindset of gratitude and abundance that inspired everyone around her.
examples.zh: 她內心隨時隨地散發著發自肺腑的感恩與富足豐盛心態，深刻鼓舞感染了身邊的每一個人。
